full_judgment:
A.K.M. Asaduzzaman, J. This rule was issued calling upon the opposite party to show cause as to why the accused petitioner should not be enlarged on bail in Misc. Case No.192 of 2010 arising out of G.R. Case No.188 of 2009 corresponding to Jhalokati P.S. Case No.14 dated 18.8.2009 under section 395/397 of the Penal Code, now pending in the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Jhalokati. 

 Prosecution case in short is that on 18.8.2009 one Momtazuddin lodged an FIR with Jhalokati Police Station alleging inter alia that 18.8.09 while he was sleeping with his family member in his dwelling house situated at west Jhalokati village at night at about 2.30 hours 10 to 12 dacoits encircled his house and some of them entered into his house by cutting grill, while he started crying, 7 to 8 dacoits in a gunpoint took away cash money and ornaments total worth of Tk.2,02,300/- at the same time they also snatched a goods ornaments amounting to Tk. 2,61,450/- belonging to his tenant Animesh. He could not recognize the accused persons. 

 The accused petitioner was arrested in connection with Jhalokati P.S. Case No.7 dated 11.7.2009 under section 457/380 of the Penal Code and moved for bail but failed, he then obtained the instant rule. 

 In the result, the rule is made absolute. The petitioner Md. Monir Hossain @ Babu, son of Md. Habibur Rahman @ Hobi may find bail on furnishing bail bond subject to the satisfaction of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Jhalokati in Misc. Case No.192 of 2010 arising out of G.R. Case No.188 of 2009 corresponding to Jhalokati P.S. Case No.14 dated 18.8.2009. The trial court however, is at liberty to cancel the bail, if the accused petitioner misuses in any way the privilege of bail.
